description: Twelve mundane scenes with four explicit anchor phrases for prompt x steering contrasts.

items.seed: A blue mug rests beside the sink; a comb catches the morning light.
A receipt lies on the counter beside a stapler under the fluorescent light.
The spreadsheet remains open while the cursor blinks beside a coffee ring and the office fan turns.
A bus card sits in a coat pocket while the handrail shines with rain.
A delivery label crosses a cardboard box beside a tape dispenser in the loading bay light.
The fridge stands open beside a lunchbox, a grocery list, and a quiet kettle.
The elevator button is cracked near an office key, a security camera, and the hallway carpet.
A phone charger coils beneath the desk lamp beside the keyboard and a line of dust.
The laundry basket waits by the door with a single sock near the washing machine.
A parking ticket rests on the windshield between the side mirror and a streetlight.
A paper cup stands beside the vending machine with a coin and a folded timetable.
An apartment key lies on the windowsill between a plant pot and the half-closed blinds.
